art_direction: observational natural-light film stills with human scale, quiet tension and a credible sense of place
palette: soft charcoal, dusk blue, warm sodium, bone white and muted green
typography: humanist Chinese sans serif with a restrained serif accent for intimate statements and captions
materials: fine film grain, natural lens falloff, tactile surfaces and controlled highlight rolloff

anchors.prompt: one subtle film-frame edge or crop
one quiet pool of warm practical light
one restrained horizon or leading line

text_layout: protect a stable low-texture field for a medium conclusion, caption or integrated line; atmosphere must support readability rather than force a giant title
contrast: bone-white or deep charcoal copy on a matte shadow, sky or softly defocused field; faces, practical lights and high-frequency textures stay outside the text zone

film-opening.label: 场景开场
film-opening.summary: 用一个真实空间和方向性光线让观众进入故事
film-opening.composition: wide establishing scene with one human-scale subject and a protected quiet edge for the conclusion
film-opening.imagery: natural-light workplace, street or service environment with honest texture and no invented signage
requirements: establish one clear place and time of day
keep the subject out of the text field

human-moment.label: 人物瞬间
human-moment.summary: 用一个动作、表情或局部细节承载页面主张
human-moment.composition: medium close-up or tactile detail with a soft practical light and a separate text-safe shadow field
human-moment.imagery: anonymous human action or object detail; identity, role and quotation attribution only when supplied
requirements: face and copy remain in separate visual fields
the action must support the supplied claim

film-comparison.label: 双场景对照
film-comparison.summary: 用两个镜头或空间的差异呈现变化
film-comparison.composition: two matched cinematic frames with the same visual dimension and a quiet central gutter
film-comparison.imagery: paired spaces, gestures or light conditions; avoid turning the page into a storyboard grid
requirements: both frames share the same comparison dimension
preserve cinematic depth without hiding copy

film-journey.label: 行动旅程
film-journey.summary: 用连续空间和动作方向讲清楚一段过程
film-journey.composition: one continuous path through a real-feeling space with a few clear action beats and a quiet caption field
film-journey.imagery: corridor, desk, service counter or landscape route; stages are visual, not numbered unless exact_text supplies numbers
requirements: separate action beats with visible breathing room

film-evidence.label: 现场证据
film-evidence.summary: 让一组有来源的数字或观察落在真实场景中
film-evidence.composition: one observational scene with a restrained data mark or chart in a clean shadow field
film-evidence.imagery: realistic environment plus minimal graphic evidence; every number and unit comes from exact_text or evidence
requirements: data remains secondary to the scene but fully readable

quiet-ending.label: 安静收束
quiet-ending.summary: 用留白、余光和一个动作把故事停在最后一句
quiet-ending.composition: quiet final frame with a receding subject or light pool and an open lower-left text field
quiet-ending.imagery: soft dusk, empty workspace or departing figure without readable signage
requirements: the final line remains legible without a title banner
